The 'Restore baseline from base branch' step's `git checkout ... || echo "..."` is a genuine best-effort fallback for an OPTIONAL file (.qa-doctor/baseline.json may legitimately not exist on the base branch yet) — not a test/build command whose failure is being hidden. The echo branch is purely informative; nothing about this PR's actual pass/fail signal is swallowed. This is a deliberate, reviewed exception, not an oversight — QA-CI-002's own falsePositiveRisk is documented as low precisely because most `|| true`/`|| echo` uses ARE real problems, and this is the rare legitimate one.
